{{Version|2.2.23}}
[[File:Fishing Button.png|frameless|left]]
Fishing is unlocked at Obelisk Level 37. When a dock's tick meter fills up there is a chance that fish from that dock will be caught. Dock ticks are added to all unlocked docks each time the green bar at the top of the screen fills. Fish can be used to purchase [[Fishing#Upgrades|fishing upgrades]] or complete [[Fishing#Notices|notices]].

The chance to successfully catch a fish is given by the following formula:

<math>\text{Catch chance (percent)} \; = \; 100 \times \frac{\text{Power on the dock}}{\text{Power rating of the fish}}</math>

Note that a catch chance greater than 100% results in a roll to catch additional fish, up to 999%. For example, having a catch chance of 342% guarantees 3 successful catches, and gives a fourth catch 42% of the time.

Having over 100% for all 4 fish in a dock AND the 4 respective poly [[cards]] for those fish allow you to catch a dock's [[Fishing#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]]. Giving tributes consisting of fish, stars, veins, bars, and gems to [[Fishing#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]] unlocks their buffs. [[Fishing#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]] have their own [[Cards#tabber-Legendary_Fish|cards]], which are guaranteed upon successfully catching the fish.

==Fishing Ticks==
Fishing ticks are the time based progression cycles used in fishing. Each tick increases a dock meter, and when that meter fills in, the game rolls for a chance to catch fish in that Dock based on the current Power Rating. The base wait time between fishing ticks is 60 seconds. However, this can be vastly decreased with [[Stats#tabber-Fishing_Tick_Reduction|Fishing Tick Reduction]]. Moreover, it is possible to obtain multiple fishing ticks at the same time via [[Stats#tabber-Double_Fish_Tick_Chance|Double Fish Tick Chance]], [[Stats#tabber-Triple_Fish_Tick_Chance|Triple Fish Tick Chance]] and [[Stats#tabber-5x_Fish_Tick_Chance|5x Fish Tick Chance]]. Ticks continue while offline and are processed when returning to the game. Ticks can also be bought from [[Lootbugs]] or gained from [[Items]].

== Docks ==
Docks act as different fishing locations, with unique landscape and various fish tied to specific dock. Each dock has it's own amount of ticks required and when a dock's tick meter fills up, there is a chance for a fish from that dock to be caught.

==Fishing Drones==
Fishing drones are units that can be assigned to docks and are obtained via [[Fishing#Upgrades|Upgrades]] and [[Fishing#Enhancements|Enhancements]]. They provide additional fishing power, which increases a chance of successfully catching fish. 

Fishing Drones can be improved by increasing their stats:
* [[Stats#tabber-Fishing_Drone_Capacity|Fishing Drone Capacity]] - Increases the total amount of Fishing Drones available to assign to docks
* [[Stats#tabber-Fishing_Drone_Base_Power|Fishing Drone Base Power]] - Increases the base power of each Fishing Drone before drone multipliers are applied
* [[Stats#tabber-Drone_Power_Multiplier| Drone Power Multiplier]] - Multiplies the power of all Fishing Drones
* Drone Cloner - Multiplies the base amount  of Fishing Drones available

== Notices ==
Notices ask for random fish in return for Fish Tokens and [[Fishing#Tier 2 Items|Tier 2 Items]]. Tokens can be spent on notice upgrades. As you complete more notices, they will ask for more fish, and fish from further docks. Tier 1 notices, however, will not ask for fish from Tier 2 docks, and vice versa. Completing more notices also slightly decreases the odds of getting certain rare [[Fishing#Tier 2 Items|Tier 2 Items]].

Notices have a mechanic that doesn't allow you to have 3 of the same fish in the notice trades at a time, so if you have 2/3 of the notice trades with the same fish, the last notice trade can't give you that fish. This can be used when you are saving fish for  [[Fishing#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]] tributes, spending all other fishes that you don't need and leaving the one you do need. It can also be used if you don't have enough of 1 specific fish but lots of the other fishes, making the most of what you have.

=== Notice Cost Caps ===
{| class="wikitable"
|+ Base Caps
!Notice Type !! Cost Cap
|-
|Easy || 250k
|-
|Medium || 500k
|-
|Hard || 750k
|-
|Expert || 1m
|}

Tier 1 Notice Cost Caps scale based on your Tier 1 Notices Completed (N1) <math>\left(1 + \left \lfloor \frac{\text{N1}}{20\text{k}} \right \rfloor \right) \times \max \left(1, \left \lfloor \frac{\text{N1}}{1\text{m}} \right \rfloor \right)</math><br>
Tier 2 Notice Cost Caps scale based on your Tier 2 Notices Completed (N2) <math>\left( 1 + \left \lfloor \frac{\text{N2}}{50\text{k}}\right\rfloor \right) \times \max \left(1, \left \lfloor \frac{\text{N2}}{1\text{m}} \right \rfloor \right)</math><br>
(i.e., the cap increases by the base cap every 20k and 50k Tier 1 and Tier 2 Notices completed, respectively. Pay attention that the brackets in the formulas are bottom brackets indicating the value inside is floored, meaning these cap increases happen at exactly 20k and 50k intervals respectively, they do not slowly increase as notices are completed). The second scaling factor every 1m notices doesn't do anything until you reach 2m notices. At 2m notices completed it doubles the cost cap and at 3m notices completed triples it.

=== Notice Rewards ===

Tier 2 item rewards from notices, [[gifts]], and [[Lootfrogs|frogs]] are chosen from a pool of [[Hamburger]], [[Starfruit|Star Fruit]], [[Lasagna]], and [[Ice cream|Ice Cream]]. There is also a chance for the reward to instead become [[Sushi]], [[Pizza]], or [[Lollipop]], with this chance decreasing as you turn in notices.

The game first rolls for [[Sushi]] with a chance of <math>\frac{1}{10 + R}</math>.<ref name="Notice Example">At 20,000 
notices: R = 11 → Sushi ~4.76%, Pizza/Lollipop ~3.23%.<br>
At 50,000 notices: R = 28 → Sushi ~2.63%, Pizza/Lollipop ~2.08%.<br>
At 175,000 notices: R = 100 → Sushi ~0.91%, Pizza/Lollipop ~0.83%.<br></ref><br>
After that, it rolls for [[Pizza]] or [[Lollipop]] with a chance of <math>\frac{1}{20 + R}</math>. If this second roll succeeds, it takes priority over [[Sushi]].

If the [[Pizza]]/[[Lollipop]] roll succeeds, [[Pizza]] has a <math>\frac{1}{3}</math> chance and [[Lollipop]] has a <math>\frac{2}{3}</math> chance.

The value <math>R</math> scales based on completed fishing notices<ref name="notice-change">In version 2.2.15 and earlier, only T1 notices were counted. From 2.2.20 onward, all notices are counted.</ref>:

<math>
R = \min\left(\left\lfloor\frac{\text{Completed Notices}}{1750}\right\rfloor, 100\right)
</math>

This means the chances for Sushi, Pizza, and Lollipop follows the graph below:
[[File:T2 item odds.png|none|thumb|The chances for Sushi, Pizza and Lollipops decreases with notices complete, up to 175k where it is capped.]]

T2 fishing notices use the same function. <ref name="notice-change"/>

==Legendary Fish==
When you have the Polychrome [[Cards|card]] for every fish in a dock and have a catch chance of at least 100% on the last fish in that dock, you are eligible to catch the legendary fish whenever that dock's bar fills. The chance to catch the legendary fish increases in increments of 1/150k per 100% catch chance on the dock's last fish, maxing out at 9/150k, or about 0.006%. The 150k value is reduced by the Angler Drone when fueled, maxing out as 81k. This means the maximum catch chance that can be attained is 9/81k, or about 0.01%.

===Legendary Fish Cards===
When you catch a legendary fish for the first time, you also get the corresponding [[Cards#tabber-Legendary Fish|legendary fish card]]. As always, you can gild the card for gems. After that, you can get polychrome shards for the card by catching the legendary fish again.

{{:Cards/Card_Effects/Legendary_Fish}}


===Tributes===
The Legendary fish by itself doesn't have any effect initially, but it can be upgraded by paying tribute to it. Tributes are late game upgrades which require vast amounts of [[Stargazing|Stars]], [[Craft|Bars]], [[Veins]], Fish and Gems to be unlocked, while at the same time they provide great bonuses.
